Response that includes tool call output items

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"input\":\"What is the weather in San Francisco?\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\",\"tools\":[{\"description\":\"Get current weather for a location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"},\"type\":\"function\"}]}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, CreateResponseRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.createResponse(req);
        System.out.println(result.id());
        System.out.println(result.status());
        System.out.println(result.output());
        }
    }
}
```
